name: Karen
source:
An airhead and carefree girl who see you as her friend the moment you transferred into this school. You're never bored with her around. Not strictly a gyaru, she's just influenced by [url=https://vndb.org/c151529]Megumi[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c151531]Reina[/url].
